glosses: knee (joint or region of the joint in the middle part of the leg between the thigh and the shank)

examples.text: Ella podía sentir cómo temblaban sus rodillas.
examples.en: She could feel her knees shaking.

examples.text: ¿No te vas a sentar en mis rodillas?
examples.en: Won't you sit on my knee?

examples.text: A Tom le duele una rodilla.
